_comment: Voice catalog. NO model weights live in this repository; `model` is a file name inside PIPER_VOICES_DIR. Both voices below are fine-tuned from the Lessac voice, so their commercial status is unresolved: see README 'Licensing caveats'. Speaker ids on the multi-speaker English model were chosen by MEASURED median pitch (scripts/lab/voice-audition.ts: 300=115 Hz, 25=149 Hz, 400=92 Hz, 60=227 Hz) so the voices are distinct; nobody has listened to them yet. Hindi: rohan (male) and priyamvada (female, CC BY-NC-SA: non-commercial). lengthScale multiplies the profile's rate: Hindi is ~2.8-3 words/s at 1.0 (measured), and one model at two rates gives two distinguishable speakers. Measured median pitch on one sentence: pratham 100 Hz (deep male), rohan 141 Hz (male), priyamvada 208 Hz (female): three distinct Hindi identities.
